chunks: Those who believe and do righteous deeds — they are the best of created beings.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the best of created beings in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, with many scholars interpreting 'the best of created beings' as a reference to the Imams who perfectly embody both faith and action. It underscores the Shia principle that true excellence requires the inseparable union of correct belief (usul) and righteous deeds (furu), elevating those who achieve this synthesis above all others.
